title: spec(liveness): app.branding.logo is live — objectui AppMark renders it at the pin
body:
Fixes #23394

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`packages/spec/liveness/app.json`, `app.branding.children.logo` flips from `planned` to `live` (`verifiedAt` 2026-10-16, `evidenceScope: "cross-repo"`).

- **Reader, read at the `.objectui-sha` pin this tree carries (`daeb77fc84`):** objectui `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppMark.tsx#AppMark` reads `branding.logo` and draws it as an `object-contain` image (it falls back to the `icon` tile when the key is absent or the image fails to load). It is mounted by `AppSwitcher#AppSwitcher` at 22 px, on the top-bar app pill and on every switcher row (the switcher is mounted in `AppHeader`), and by `UnifiedSidebar#UnifiedSidebar` at 26 px, in the phone drawer header. All three are cited in `evidence`.
- **`producer`:** kept and re-pinned to `daeb77fc`. The designer's `AppCreationWizard`, `BrandingEditor` and `EditAppPage` still write or pre-fill `branding.logo` at the pin.
- **`note`:** rewritten to say what renders it. The "PLANNED, carrier objectui#10827" and "Flip to `live`" wording is gone, and so is the paragraph about objectui's top-level `logo`, because objectui has since retired that second spelling. The ONE SPELLING paragraph stays, because it is still true: `AppSchema` declares only `branding.logo`, and the alias table answers an app-level `logo` with `branding` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`).
- **`branding` container `note`:** only the sentence about `logo` is changed. It now says `logo` reached nothing mounted at the 2026-09-27 drill and has since gone `live` through `AppMark`.
- **`state-counts/app.md`:** regenerated with `gen:liveness-counts`. Before: `live 50 · planned 1`. After: `live 51 · planned 0`. `classified` stays 59.
- **Changeset:** a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/spec`. `liveness/` is in the package's `files[]`, so the ledger ships.

No schema, objectui file or `.objectui-sha` changes.

## Verification

At head `0a6dbaf4`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness`: exit 1 before the regeneration (the expected count drift, `| app | 50 | 0 | 0 | 8 | 1 | 59 |` to `| app | 51 | 0 | 0 | 8 | 0 | 59 |`), then exit 0 after `gen:liveness-counts`. Every `live` entry's repo-local evidence resolves, and `state-counts/` is current.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 62 commands for this diff. 59 exited 0, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:generated` among them, after a spec build. 3 exited 3 because a prerequisite was missing (NOT MEASURED, left to CI): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` need a full workspace build, and `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needs an unshallowed clone. `--ran` reconciles: 62 derived, 59 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

## Acceptance notes

- The ledger file's top-level `_note` still has the dated 2026-09-27 sentence "`branding` is now DRILLED: `logo` is `planned` with carrier objectui#10827". It records history and sits outside this card's claimed file surface (the row and the container note only), so it is left as it was.
- `docs/audits/2026-06-appschema-property-liveness.md` lists `branding.logo` among the unimplemented keys. It is a dated audit snapshot, not a current-state page, and it is left as it was.
